note: The English bio quotes no scripture verbatim and carries no Book C:V citations; every quotation in it is M’Cheyne’s own words (diary, letters, the Daily Bread preface), translated here, not drawn from Kulish.
The preface's 'feeding in the same portion of the green pasture' alludes to Psalm 23:2 but is M’Cheyne's own sentence, not a quotation, so no reference is recorded for it.

Name rendered Мак-Чейн, matching the uk hub prose and the uk editions of power-through-prayer, absolute-surrender and the-secret-of-guidance; men-who-tended-the-flock-2.uk spells it Макчейн — a split for the native reviewer to settle.
'Writer to the Signet' rendered «письменник печатки» with the English title kept in parentheses, as it is a Scottish legal office with no Ukrainian equivalent.
